source: Fix employee form workspace and improve form guidance

assumptions.text: The fixed viewport workspace applies on desktop only; mobile retains safe stacked page scrolling as confirmed by the designer.
Compass ScrollArea is used only for the active employee form content.
Breadcrumbs, page heading, progress, employee tabs, CD impact, and footer remain stationary while the form scrolls.
The CD impact summary is compact enough to remain fully visible at a 1440 by 768 desktop viewport.
Premium line items use a two-column compact summary while retaining all supplied amounts.
Form sections use consistent card surfaces and numbered badges instead of similar tinted backgrounds.
Basic information, insurance plans, and dependents calculate completion independently.
A contextual next-step alert guides the user to the first incomplete section.
